`media-sample.webm` is a 4-second synthetic VP8/Opus test clip: red for the first two seconds, then blue, with a 440 Hz sine wave. `media-sample.mp4` is the same synthetic clip converted to H.264/AAC for testing a common phone-video container. `media-hd-silent.webm` is a 1920×1080 silent solid-colour clip for testing downscaling. All were generated locally and contain no third-party media or production data.
